title: Visible labels and accessible names
change_reason: Original source-grounded pilot draft; human review pending.
claim: For web controls displaying text labels, keep that wording within the accessible name so speech users can refer to the control by what they see.

constraints: Additional naming context must remain accurate

confidence_rationale: Proposed scope interpretation grounded in a normative criterion and its same-origin explanation; human review pending. Confidence describes this interpretation, not whether the standard is optional.
limitations: Applies to the stated text-label scope; not a rule requiring text on every icon.
Does not establish full accessibility conformance.
Two W3C pages do not satisfy the independent-source gate.
